topic: The Fundamental Bridge: The Relationship Between Integrals and Derivatives

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Velocity-Position Analogy
lecture_lines: Imagine a squirrel gathering nuts daily.
Velocity describes how fast it travels.
Like unwrapping a gift, we reverse.
animations: Create a squirrel [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/squirrel.svg] moving linearly across the screen representing velocity. Color: #FFD700.
Display a MathTex 'v = dx/dt' near the squirrel [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/squirrel.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.
Flash the nuts [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/nuts.svg] near the squirrel to emphasize constant velocity. Color: #FF4500.

sections.title: Visualizing the Derivative: The Slope Tool
lecture_lines: A derivative is a magnifying glass.
It focuses on slope at one point.
Watch the tangent line move across.
animations: Draw a tangent line touching a curve at point (x, f(x)). Color: #00BFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/magnifying.svg]
Display MathTex 'f\'(x) = lim_{h->0}...' to define the slope. Color: #FFFFFF.
Animate the tangent line sliding along the curve to show changing slope. Color: #00BFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/magnifying.svg]

sections.title: Visualizing the Integral: The Accumulator
lecture_lines: The integral is like a painter.
It accumulates area under the curve.
A bar sweeps, tracking the total.
animations: Create a shaded region under a curve from a to b. Color: #32CD32. Use [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/paintbrush.svg] to fill the region.
Display MathTex 'A = integral_a^b f(x) dx'. Color: #FFFFFF.
Show vertical bars filling the area progressively. Color: #32CD32. Use [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/paintbrush.svg] to render the bars.

sections.title: The Fundamental Theorem: Connecting the Two
lecture_lines: Integrating f of x gives F.
Differentiating F returns the original f.
animations: Display both the curve and the area simultaneously. Colors: #00BFFF, #32CD32.
Animate the area growing as the upper limit changes. Color: #32CD32.
Flash the relationship equation 'F\'(x) = f(x)'. Color: #FFD700.

sections.title: Synthesis & Summary
animations: Display summary text listing Derivative vs Integral. Colors: #00BFFF, #32CD32.
Show an arrow connecting the two concepts. Color: #FFFFFF.
Fade all elements out sequentially. Color: #FFFFFF.
